dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree incline relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle approximately 130 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan monochromatic texture and visible polygonal facet aliasing along the ventral and caudal boundaries.
